results.title: The Dutchman
results.overview: A successful black businessman, haunted by his crumbling marriage and identity crisis, is drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a mysterious white woman he encounters on a New York subway.

results.title: Alas
results.overview: When directing a music video for an indie artist, queer and undocumented Nico receives a career-defining opportunity abroad, forcing him to weigh between ambition and sacrifice, knowing either path comes with irreversible consequences.

results.title: Conscious
results.overview: Dylan's sleepless nights come back to haunt him.

results.title: Death Name
results.overview: A young Korean American woman yearns to learn more about her heritage, not knowing the further she digs, the more she reawakens a deadly family curse.

results.title: Area Codes
results.overview: A girl from Stockton, Gabriella, breaks up with her long-term boyfriend and decides to help her best friend move to Los Angeles as a short getaway. At the biggest night market in LA, she meets a boy who was born and raised in SoCal, Jayson, and he shows her iconic and sentimental places within every area code of the greater LA area.

results.title: Frankenstein's Bride
results.overview: On the day of Frankenstein’s Monster’s wedding, villagers riot and kill him. His bride escapes, vows revenge on the townsfolk responsible, and eventually resurrects the Monster – leading a trail of blood in her wake.

results.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
results.original_title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
results.overview: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

results.title: Warga Rusun 609
results.overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

results.title: Payback
results.overview: After four women discover they were all duped by the same seemingly ideal man, they unite into a secret, highly strategic team dedicated to exposing his lies and executing a master plan of revenge.

results.title: Chimp Outbreak
results.overview: An aggressive chimp has escaped confinement and creates a path of death and destruction.

results.title: The Jobcentre
results.overview: „Alone against the mob? Solo against the jobcentre? Classic suicide mission.” That much Mr Berger knows, working at the jobcentre phone support line. But fortunately, Marie is not alone, after she loses her job aged 58. She has gathered a highly specialized troop of long-term unemployed people, and together they can achieve anything.

results.title: Night Stage
results.overview: An actor and a politician start a secret affair and together discover their fetish for having sex in public places. The closer they get to their dream of fame, the more they feel the urge to put themselves at risk.

results.title: Act One
results.overview: A young aspiring actress, desperate for guidance and belonging, falls under the spell of a manipulative acting coach who draws her into a web of control and obsession.

results.title: No Name, No Address
results.overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

results.title: If I Were You 3
results.overview: Two decades after their last body swap, Cláudio and Helena are living a new phase of their lives alongside their daughter Bia, now an adult and married with Aquiles. Everything seems balanced until an unexpected situation shakes up the family dynamic and puts their relationships to the test. When lightning seems to strike the same place again, the whole family is forced to learn to put themselves in each other's shoes, in a very literal way.

results.title: My Duchess
results.overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

results.title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
results.overview: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

results.title: System
results.overview: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.
